objects.description: [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has deleted preexisting scheduled tasks and created malicious versions of the same named task to execute automatically at system start to include tasks named `UpdateSystem` and `UpdateUser`.(Citation: MSTI_GentelmenRansomware_May2026) [The Gentlemen Ransomware](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9051) has also leveraged naming conventions that mimic legitimate VMware services.(Citation: CheckPointResearch_TheGentlemen_April2026)
